headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, Rocky Romero laced up for their first AEW match against Bryan Danielson, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.60 ? a match that delivered. Romero's Dynamite in-ring debut, and a first meeting with Danielson since 2008 ? Orange Cassidy scouted from ringside for his own upcoming Full Gear match, adding real intrigue to a hard-fought, technically sharp opener.
Rewind to 2023, when FTR vs. Komander & Vikingo headlined Rampage, rated 8.08 ? a real highlight of the night in a physical tag team battle.

That Wednesday in 2021, Lee Moriarty stepped through the curtain for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.67 ? a match that delivered. Lee Moriarty was the clear standout of this tag match, using his size advantage to dominate two much smaller, faster opponents ? a real showcase performance that got the crowd firmly behind him, even in a losing effort.
